what: Inside the area, the guide text (“Click to enter”) trails the cursor with a .12 ratio lag, and tilts around the Y and X axes with 800px perspective by the distance it hasn’t caught up (.15° per 1px) — move fast and the text lies down like paper, stop and it stands up at once. It turns on in .3s on entering and off on leaving. On touch devices it stays centered.

options.tilt: Tilt per 1px of distance (degrees), default .15 — 0 means no tilt

from.where: shared.js entry gate .p-gate__label — original translate3d(…) perspective(800px) rotateY·rotateX
